name: Website Uptime, SSL Expiry and Price Watcher to Telegram

parameters.content:
## Website Uptime, SSL Expiry & Price Watcher

### Required Environment Variables
- `WATCH_TARGET_URLS`: Comma-separated list of URLs to probe (e.g. `https://example.com,https://status.example.com`)
- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`: Telegram Bot API token
- `TELEGRAM_ALERT_CHAT_ID`: Target Telegram chat or group ID

### Optional Environment Variables
- `WATCH_MAX_LATENCY_MS`: Latency threshold in milliseconds (default: `2500`)
- `WATCH_PRICE_REGEX`: Regex pattern to extract a price or status token from the response body
- `WATCH_EXPECTED_PRICE`: Expected matched string; alerts when extracted value differs
- `WATCH_SSL_MIN_DAYS`: Minimum days remaining if upstream exposes an `x-ssl-expiry-days` header (default: `14`)
